worldcombat.skill.silktrap.summary: Spins a silk web to protect the user, blocking foes' damaging moves up to a total pool (excess still lands) and snaring enemies whose contact attacks hit it — cutting their Speed and pinning them in place; status moves pass through.
worldcombat.skill.silktrap.description.0: Spins a web around the user to protect itself: it lasts up to %1$s ticks (ending early once its pool is spent) and blocks up to a total of %2$s damage from foes' damaging moves, with any excess still landing; a foe whose contact attack strikes the web loses %3$s Speed levels and is pinned for %4$s ticks (unable to move), once per attacker per web. Higher Speed and Defence make the web tougher and longer-lasting.
worldcombat.skill.silktrap.description.2: Weaving the web again in quick succession gets riskier: from the second consecutive cast each repeat adds about 25% to the failure chance (less at higher levels), resetting after about 12 seconds without use, and a failed cast is wasted. Current failure chance %1$s; current Snare setting %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.silktrap.use.0: Snare a charging melee so it is slow and stuck
worldcombat.skill.silktrap.use.1: Buy time to open distance for allies
worldcombat.skill.silktrap.use.2: Soak ranged damage with the toughest web
worldcombat.skill.silktrap.preference.sn: On (snare): contact pin x1.5, drop +1, but pool x0.8, duration x0.85, recover 7 ticks. Off (slide): pool x1.25, duration x1.15, recover 5 ticks, but pin x0.6, no extra drop.
worldcombat.skill.silktrap.preference.ai: Weave once a threat enters this range. Larger sets up earlier but may waste the cast; smaller saves PP but bets the foe will close in.
worldcombat.skill.silktrap.description.p: The web only stops foes' damaging moves: status moves pass straight through, and attacks from allies do not spend it.
